headline: Spain: July inflation rises to 3.6%, highest since May 2024
summary: Spanish inflation reached 3.6% in July, its highest since May 2024 and a fifth straight month above 3%, partly due to electricity and fuel prices and the partial blockage of the Strait of Hormuz.
why: Inflation data shapes expectations for European Central Bank policy, bond yields and consumer purchasing power in Spain, the euro area's fourth-largest economy.
